# Parley v0.1.42

One fix: **Ask with Context** on an agent-staged draft is now a real,
tracked Ask. Nothing else changed.

## The context Ask was never recorded

v0.1.41 stopped the freeze, and the next test showed what had been hiding
behind it. Confirming **Ask with Context** on a reviewed draft delivered the
pack to the target, and the target replied in its own terminal, but Status
Center showed no question, no active handoff and nothing new in History. The
route was pasting the pack straight into the pane and recording only the
review's completion; no Ask existed for the target to answer, and the button,
the confirmation and Help all said otherwise.

Now the reviewed pack becomes one correlated Ask through the same engine as
the toolbar Ask: from the draft's source pane to the pane you chose, attributed
to you. The target receives the pack ending with `parley answer <id>`, Status
Center counts the question and shows it waiting, and when the target answers
that id the answer arrives as the returned result on that handoff and Status
Center opens on it, exactly as a toolbar Ask does. The review shows Completed
and names the Ask it became.

Three edges are handled honestly:

- If the target is already busy with a question or tracked work, nothing is
  sent, the draft comes back to you unchanged with a "Not sent" reason, and no
  handoff is recorded.
- If delivery into the pane fails, the review is marked failed with the
  reason and Status Center shows a failed Ask.
- If the target never answers, the Ask times out like any other and the
  review still records that it was sent.

## Also

- **Set Routing Role** always shows an outcome. The field takes focus when
  the dialog opens, an empty entry gets an alert instead of doing nothing, and
  the result, success or refusal, is shown once the dialog has closed. A test
  run on v0.1.41 set the role on two panes with no visible outcome and no role
  recorded on either; if that recurs on this build, it will now say so. A new
  check proves a routing role is refused for a second pane in the same
  workspace and allowed in a different one, which is by design.
- `docs/test-scenarios.md` gains the Status Center expectation for the
  context Ask (P2.6), the badge and refusal for roles (P3.2), and a note for
  Codex users: with `approvals_reviewer = "auto_review"` in your Codex config,
  Codex sends sandbox escalations to its own automatic reviewer and shows no
  prompt, and Codex documents that an allowed escalation still runs without
  network. Parley's PERMISSION REPORTED indicator is accurate in that case;
  the prompt's absence is Codex's configuration, not Parley's.

## Compatibility

Agent protocol unchanged at 32; no pane needs restarting. The review record
gains nothing new; only its detail text changes. Older approvals without the
UI's key still work; the core derives one from the review.

Validated: 342 native checks, 53 Node tests, public scan, platform scan and
build. The check that pinned the old direct paste was replaced by one that
pins the correlated Ask, its refusal and its failure states; it was watched
failing against the old route and passing against the new one. Two other
checks that exercised the old route now answer the Ask from the target side.

Not validated here: the route driven by hand in the running app. It is P2.6
in `docs/test-scenarios.md` and the first thing to try on this build.

Unnotarized test beta: ad-hoc signed without the hardened runtime, not
notarized, no automatic updates. Install only from the expected GitLab
release after checking SHA256SUMS.
